outcome: Time to first analgesia request postoperatively
cohort: 40 patients presenting for lumbar spine surgery at Sri Siddhartha Medical College and Research Institute in Tumkur, Karnataka, India.
finding: Ultrasound-guided bilateral erector spinae block significantly extended the duration of postoperative pain relief (mean time to first analgesia request: 7:28 hrs) and reduced the need for first rescue analgesia compared to ultrasound-guided caudal block (mean time to first analgesia request: 4:04 hrs) in lumbar spine surgeries.
